svg.title: One zip for the players and for the store
svg.desc: From the signed tag, the job assets of the project runs scripts/release-assets.sh, without a token that may write and without a secret. The job release assets describes the zip in the SBOMs, attests it and attaches it to the draft, and the published release can't change any more. A player downloads the zip and loads it unpacked. publish-store.yml checks its signed provenance and its version, and the Chrome Web Store gets exactly that file; a release without the zip, a zip without a valid provenance or of another version stays off the store, and the run fails.
